omega_r.requirement: One derived/provenance-backed radiation-density convention shared by all runtimes.
omega_r.falsifier: Cross-runtime parity requires hidden per-runtime Omega_r substitution.

hz_dataset.requirement: Choose a canonical scientific surface by explicit independence/covariance/provenance criteria; preserve other surfaces as named projections.

growth_mode.requirement: Canonical promotion requires a validated RLL perturbation/growth completion with baseline recovery; proxies remain engineering projections.
growth_mode.falsifier: Background-only proxy is labeled full physical growth.

bao_sound_horizon.requirement: r_d calculation passes versioned reference/convergence gates.

cmb_acoustic_mode.requirement: CMB acoustic scale uses r_s(z_star) under the canonical contract; compressed prior remains distinct from full Planck likelihood.

distance_integration.requirement: Version absolute/relative convergence tolerance and demonstrate stable observables under step refinement.

cross_runtime_parity.requirement: Exact parity only on explicitly common semantics and data surface; semantic divergences stay named.

non_negotiable: claim_allowed=false until independent scientific gates permit otherwise
